explain.unavailable: Jev was unavailable ({{error}}), so the hybrid run fell back to {{rule}} and chose {{action}}.
explain.sameRule: Both modes choose {{action}}. Policy rule {{rule}} fires on the facts alone, so Jev's signals don't change the outcome.
explain.sameAction: Both modes choose {{action}}, through different policy rules ({{rulesRule}} and {{hybridRule}}).
explain.differWithSignals: The facts alone send this customer to {{rulesAction}} ({{rulesRule}}). With Jev's signals (switching risk {{switching}}, needs attention {{attention}}, objective {{objective}} ({{probability}})), policy rule {{hybridRule}} chooses {{hybridAction}} instead.
explain.differ: The facts alone send this customer to {{rulesAction}} ({{rulesRule}}). With Jev, policy rule {{hybridRule}} chooses {{hybridAction}} instead.

healthy.title: Healthy account
healthy.description: Stable relationship with no immediate signal.
notes: The customer confirmed they are satisfied with delivery reliability and product quality.
Purchasing renewed the supply agreement for another year.
The account manager reports a constructive relationship and steady order plans.

churn.title: Andes Retail switching risk
churn.description: Strategic account showing signs of supplier switching.
notes: The customer said a competitor offered better commercial conditions.
Purchasing is evaluating alternative suppliers for next quarter.

upsell.title: Upsell opportunity
upsell.description: Growing account with interest in additional products.
notes: The buyer asked for pricing on two additional product lines.
A new store opening next quarter will require higher volumes.
The customer is satisfied with current service and has no overdue balance.

payment.title: Payment issue
payment.description: Overdue invoices take precedence over other signals.
notes: Two invoices remain unpaid after their due dates.
Accounts payable acknowledged the balance but has not committed to a payment date.
The buyer wants to continue ordering once the balance is resolved.

ambiguous.title: Ambiguous signals
ambiguous.description: Conflicting information calls for human review.
notes: Purchasing asked whether prices can be held for the next quarter and mentioned comparing market offers.
The same buyer said they value our reliable deliveries and intend to renew the relationship.
No supplier change has been approved, but the next purchase forecast remains uncertain.

roles.title: Four roles, one decision
roles.description: Rules derive hard facts. Jev, an AI model, judges what the data can't state for sure. Policy decides what's allowed, and BPMN carries it out.

scenario.title: Pick a customer
scenario.description: Each scenario is a CRM record. The tour uses Andes Retail: a strategic account whose notes mention a competitor.

mode.title: Rules only, or Rules + Jev
mode.description: Rules only decides on facts alone. Rules + Jev adds AI signals the policy can read. Jev never picks the action.

compare.title: Run both modes
compare.description: Next sends the same customer through both modes at once.

verdict.title: Same customer, different answers?
verdict.description: Each card shows the action a mode chose and the policy rule behind it. The sentence below says why they differ, built from the run itself.

diagram.title: Follow the path
diagram.description: The bronze line is the path the process took; skipped branches fade. Notes show what each step found. Click the other card to redraw it.

jev.title: Signals, not decisions
jev.description: Jev returns probabilities with confidence. The policy reads them through fixed, testable thresholds, so every action traces back to a rule.

palette.title: Build the process
palette.description: Drag events, tasks and gateways onto the canvas. This is a standard BPMN 2.0 modeler (bpmn-js).

tasks.title: Tasks that call decisions
tasks.description: Business rule tasks (the table icon) evaluate a decision table. Select one to set which decision it calls.

input.title: Input for a run
input.description: An example request for this process is filled in. Edit it to try other paths.

run.title: Run it
run.description: Runs the process on the server with bpmn-engine and ZEN.

path.title: The path, drawn
path.description: The bronze path is what the engine executed; skipped branches fade. Edit the diagram and the highlight clears.
